rationale: The schedule's last combined total row is the grand total: $16,508,590 thousand of other investments plus $343,539 thousand in the separately presented affiliated money market fund equals $16,852,129 thousand. The companyfacts value captured only the former subtotal. The grand total is 96.23% of total assets of $17,512,572 thousand and leaves a plausible non-investment remainder of $660,443 thousand.
